test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a circular race of 1100 m, P and Q start from the same point, at the same time and at speeds of 36 km/h and 63 km/h, respectively. When will they meet again for the first time on the track if they are running in the opposite direction?
solution:
**Given:**

Track length = 1100 m

Speed of P = 36 km/h = 36 × (1000/3600) = 10 m/s

Speed of Q = 63 km/h = 63 × (1000/3600) = 17.5 m/s

P and Q are running in opposite directions.

**Formula used:**

Relative speed when running in opposite directions = Speed of P + Speed of Q

Time to meet = Track length / Relative speed

**Calculation:**

Relative speed = 10 + 17.5 = 27.5 m/s

⇒ Time to meet = 1100 / 27.5

⇒ Time to meet = 40 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
